Section 13: Shutdown
  1. Finish the current stroke and stop the feeder.
  2. Raise the ram to top dead centre.
  3. Switch the controller to standby.
  4. Close the lubrication valve.
  5. Lower the guard and lock it.
  6. Isolate the hydraulic pump.
  7. Record the stroke counter in the press log.
  8. Hang the tag LOTO-7C on the main isolator and log the shutdown time.
